These things could be yours.

This is the Ectofuntus, the most marvellous creation of Necrovarus, our glorious leader.

This is the Emir's Arena...duh!

This land has seen better days, but I have no doubt that Father Sugadinti will guide us into making it a new paradise.

This man walks over to me and says that it's my stop, absurd though that is.

This map leads to the lair of the beast that destroyed my home, devoured my family, and burned to a cinder all that I love. But revenge would not benefit me now, and to disturb this beast is to risk bringing its wrath down upon another land.
This map will show you where you will need to dig, or what you will need to search to get the next clue.
This master you speak of...
This may be the case. I am willing to give you a chance; if you impress me enough, I will consider trusting you as our regent.

This might be a little tricky as you will need to go into the Lumbridge Swamp caves. You will need a light source! Never forget your light source down there!

This might sound a little strange... but Rumpty Bumpty fell off a wall.
This might well work. Yes, an outsider to the city might have considerably more influence than one might expect, if we play our cards right.

This morning, you were nothing more than ants, scrambling to find purpose amongst the dirt. Now though... now you have achieved ascension.

This paper, as you call it, contains strategies for use in the war against the lizardmen. The details are a military secret, so do not ask any more questions.
This part of the world is riddled with caves! It's hard not to hit a cave around here! Are you sure you're not just picking up these goblin lanterns or something stupid?
This passage could be the least of our worries soon though. Before long, the vampyres will be able to cross at any point of the river. We won't be able to reinforce all of it.
This passage is currently the only route between Morytania and Misthalin. The barrier here draws power from the river.
This passage leads to the lair of what your kind call the Alchemical Hydra. It is an ancient beast, the only one of its kind.
This path leads to the Doors of Dinh. You should be careful if you wish to travel any further.
This pathetic holiday will come to an end and I'll laugh as it burns.
This peace treaty specifies the border between Lumbridge and the Cave Goblin realm. Please take it to the cave goblins and tell them I would like to meet with their leader to sign it.
This person has a lot of uniforms, but I shouldn't take more than I need.
This place gives me the creeps!
This place has been cursed. Our people have angered the gods and have fled the village.
This place has remained vulnerable ever since.
This place has sat in ruin for an age, slowly destroyed by the harsh climate of the Wilderness.
This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
This place is a maze - got any advice?
This place is a prison. Here, a being of incomprehensible power was sealed away. Things would have stayed that way, if not for our foolishness.
This place is a union of the mystical and the mundane, where the magical realm reaches out to touch the humdrum world of commerce.
This place is beautiful. I thought it was supposed to be a prison?
This place is bizarre!
This place is brilliant! The apprentices are looking around to see what they can discover. You should join them!
This place is called Mort'ton, it used to be a quiet town with a specialism in death. That is to say that many burial tombs were created here in the naturally formed caves under this very village.
This place is filled to the brim with wealthy folk with lots of pricey stuff. It's all prime for the takin'.
This place is private! You're not welcome here!
This place is remarkable! Let's have a look around and see what we can find.
This place isn't as big as the old hideout but it will do for now.
This place probably had a name at some point but it has long since been forgotten. The Arceuus librarians refer to this place as the Forthos Dungeon.
This place rocks!
This place used to be very beautiful, however, as our king grows old and weak, the land seems to be dying too.
This place was built long before the city of Darkmeyer existed, back when this land was known as Hallowvale.
This place...? Why, This is the great Fortis Colosseum!
This place? It's the castle crypt. The greatest White Knights are buried here, after a lifetime in the service of Saradomin. At least, that's how it used to be.
This place? Why, this is Rellekka! Homeland of all Fremennik! I do not recognise your face outerlander; Where do you come from?
This polishing wheel...
This poor family. I don't know how much more they can take.
This power station keeps breaking. I can fix it easily with parts from the old power generator on the other side of the cavern, but that's not easy to get to.
This power you speak of... You refer to the power found in the Temple of the Eye?
This power, she gave it to me! It's her power too! Feel it!
This power... I've felt it before...
This proof is displayed as a gold star next to your name on the group sidepanel. Note that if you join an existing group, you will not be considered an original member.
This puzzle has three answers and you'll need to tell me all of them.
This quest is not available on Speedrunning Worlds.
This railing is broken and needs to be replaced.
This railing is now fixed.
This raises more questions than answers. Was this actually a murder, or just a robbery gone wrong? And how was there a hidden room that we knew nothing about?
This really is a FINE bit of thievery.
This really is my passion.
This realm... sapping strength... combat capability impaired...
This recent situation has been most unfortunate. People are angry, I understand that. That said, Sophia Hughes has been dealt with. It's time for Martin Holt and his protestors to go home.
This reminds me of my last holiday.
This result can only mean one thing... there is no plague. It seems that someone has been lying about all of it. The only question is... why?
This riddle of mine may confuse, I am quite sure of that. Mayhap you should closely peruse Every word i have spat?
This ring allowed me to continue my work without feeling the effects that aging was having on my body. I suppose I have no use for it now. I guess you can keep it.
This ring is a symbol of your exploration of Lumbridge and Draynor. It can recharge half of your run energy twice per day and cast low level alchemy without runes 30 times per day.
This rock seems a lot smaller than our bard made it out to be.
This rock was called the 'Rune Essence' by the magicians who studied its powers. Apparently, by simply breaking a chunk from it, a Rune Stone could be fashioned very quickly and easily at certain
This rock would never be consumed, no matter how much we took, and sparkled at its peak, and broke off in small and regular sized chunks when mined.
This room is dominated by a colossal horned skeleton!
This room is familiar... as I look around, I feel something stirring...
This room is fascinating...
This room is for partying the night away!
This room is part of the Tower?
This room isn't a lot of use on its own... Maybe I can get extra help from the inside somehow... I wonder if any of the other players have found a way in.
This sad and afflicted little town is called 'Mort'ton'. In it's heyday it was a busy and bustling market town with a speciality for interring the dead.
This salesman came around selling this poison that could fix anything. I think most everyone bought some to use for chores around the mansion.
This salvaging hook is a bit too complicated for me.
This sanctuary has been sealed for centuries and it's full to the brim with history of my sect... Everything is interesting!
This scroll is a collection of writings. Some of them are just scraps of papyrus with what looks like random scribblings. Which would you like to read?
This sculptor has got me looking for a lot of items, you see.
This seed may only be planted close to Glarial's remians.
This seems like a bad idea...
This seems once again an effort on your behalf to throw the trail away from your own jinxed self bringing us misfortune.
This seems to be a small sack filled with venom.
This seems to be all in order. Welcome to the Death Guard. Now, for your first assignment...
This seems to be all in order. Welcome to the Death Guard. Now, for your first assignment... As you may know, part of what we do here is keep the people believing in the plague...
This seems to be the fang of a relatively small creature. It's absolutely soaked in venom.
This shady fellow is a member of the Zamorakian Magical Institute.
This shell can be compressed into a ball or fanned out like leaves, in order to sense odours. The front legs are adapted for digging the enormous tunnel systems that serve as their nests.
This shield is a symbol of your exploration of Falador. It can restore one quarter of your prayer points once per day and you can now access a shortcut to the Chaos temple from Burthorpe.
This shield turned up, recently... I believe it belongs to you.
This ship? Does it have something to do with your old crew?
This should be an interesting task. How many sq'irks do you want?
This should give him enough of a scare to deputise you immediately.
This should not concern you, outerlander. I am awaiting other Fremenniks to join me on an expedition to Waterbirth Island.
This should work nicely now that I've fixed it.
This shouldn't take too long. I just want to ask you a bit about your great Grandfather, the one who lived in the outpost?
This soul remained.
This sounds interesting indeed.
This sounds like a scam.
This sounds pretty grave, please go on.
This sounds very serious. Hmm, I'd best get back to the mainland and see where these lobsters are heading.
This spell needs to be cast in the swamp after you have been blessed. I'm afraid you'll need to go to the temple to the North and ask a member of the clergy to bless you.
This stone seems to have strange markings on it.

This stone seems to have strange markings on it. Maybe Trufitus can decipher them? THe stone is too heavy to carry but the letters stand proud on a plaque. Maybe you could seperate[sic] the plaque from the rock?
This stout seems absolutely vile and disgusting. Besides, I'm supposed to bring it to my drunken, kebab obsessed friend.
This string you'll be wanting... Very rare. Take a lot of time to recreate. Not sure you have the cash for it.
This stump is all that remains of the Great Auburn Redwood. It was, and in many ways still is, one of the key holy sites of Varlamore.
This summoning is our chance to rid the world of his evil influence!

This sword is a symbol of your exploration of the Wilderness. Speak to Lundail at the Mage Arena every day to receive 40 free runes and you can teleport to either Edgeville or Ardougne from the Wilderness lever.
This table might be useful with some adjustment.
This task will be much greater than the last two. I hope you are prepared for it.
This tax does seem a little harsh on you.
This technique fully embraces your strength as a barbarian. Nuance is not required here. It's about the fine art of smashing pots.

This temple was built atop Tapoyauik, a ruined fortress of the Old Ones. They walked the world during the last cycle, and when the time came for their cycle to end, they embraced their destiny willingly.
This temple was built to house a powerful artefact. Many sought to claim this artefact for themselves, including servants of the Fallen Empire.
This time the King has decided to tax facial hair!
This time they'll survive, I hope.
This time your goblin friend cannot help you. You are on your own and have no way to overcome my prayers!
This time, it is all about me! I'm the star of the show! ME ME ME ME ME!
This time, try not to drop it.
This time-travelling stuff just has me a little worn out ok?
This told us a lot about how the goblin body shape changed from its surface form to that of the cave goblins.
This torch schematic. It's a fake.
This torn page was on a lectern in the tomb, do you know why?
This totem pole will take pride of place in the Legends' Guild, as a reminder of your quest. The legends of the future will surely be inspired by such a feat of craftsmanship.
This tower. Set me back a fair few million.
This town has recently become home to an illness known as the Sleeper Plague. It's a nasty affliction. Those infected fall into a deep sleep, never to wake.
This town is so boring now. Want to spice things up a bit?
This track leads right up to Keldagrim. Only stop.
This trial is to determine the guilt or innocence of Anna Sinclair for the murder of Lord Sinclair.
This troll settlement is a relatively new addition to the area. It is what was here before that will be of interest to the killer.
This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium and above.
This type of clue can be as simple as talk to the specified person or searching a crate in a specified location.
This type of clue has you talk to someone around Gielinor. Although the clue does not tell you exactly who to talk to.
This type of clue has you talk to someone around Gielinor. Although the clue does not tell you exactly who to talk to. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium, hard and elite.
This type of clue has you work out a logical problem for the person you need to talk to. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium, hard and elite.
This type of clue will give you a location that you will need to visit, along with some items you will need.
This type of clue will have you use a sextant, chart and a watch to find out the place you will need to dig. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium and above.
This type of clue will show you a map of an area.
This type of clue will show you which fairy ring code you will need to use to get to the right place to dig.
This vessel is useless! The Karambwan are not even interested in entering it!
This vyre was trying to steal some of my prisoners. I was having them removed.
This war has taken so much... From my people, and from yours. I'd give anything to see peace, anything to finally see Prifddinas with my own eyes.
This was a priceless artefact, and it was at risk! I knew it had to be protected, and there was nowhere better than in Varrock...
This was after Imperium had already been delivered to the east!

This was all a pretence, of course. As part of his duties he was allowed access to many exotic and esoteric foodstuffs. These allowed him to experiment with his magic and increase his power exponentially.
This was from the early days of Dorgesh-Kaan. It must have been before our ancestors' eyes reached their current size.
This was obviously a bit of a blow, you can't make a new attraction without any animals.
This was our real home. Not that town back there, or that castle. This here is the last place we were truly who we were meant to be.
This was over the second we agreed to Vanescula's plan! Now all of us are living on borrowed time. Me, you, Ivan, Safalaan... None of us are getting out of this alive.
This was the tree where we first met. It was a lovely day! A botanical tour of the rainforest, but the only thing I found myself looking at was her...
This was, of course, before the building started to sink into the swamp...
This washed up on the beach earlier. I thought you could get it fixed by Smithing Smith in Mos Le'Harmless. It could be valuable.
This water doesn't look particularly holy to me... I think I'd better check with Drezel first.
This way, Azali.
This weekend?
This whole city is a plague issue!
This whole place is very fancy.
This whole situation with Councillor Hughes has caused enough civil unrest. We certainly don't need it to get any worse.
This will allow all able-bodied men to fight in the defence of Misthalin for glory and spoils. You will find that many sword arms from Misthalin should soon join the resistance force.
This will apply on members' worlds and non-members' worlds alike.
This will be a challenge.
This will be your death!
This will come in very handy in the future but we can't arrest someone on just this. I'm afraid you'll still need to find more evidence before we can close this case completely.
This will consume the contract.
This will consume the scroll.
This will cut down you to size!
This will hit the spot. Oh yes. Thanks.
This will restore balance.
This will summon a mighty spirit named Thrantax.
This will tax what little magic I possess however, so you will have to manually travel to the bank to withdraw them again.
This word... Mokhaiotl... I only heard it once, when things neared the end. It was not clear to me what it was, but when they spoke of it... it was the first time I'd heard them speak with hope.
This work isn't going to do itself.
This workbench is too complicated. You need instructions to follow.
This world around us... is an online game... called Old School RuneScape.
This would be easier if you told the truth.
This would explain why used camel salesmen are in such a hurry to be rid of them.
This would probably make a nice home.
This wouldn't be about that old relic being stolen from Entrana, would it?
This wouldn't be that old relic being stolen from Entrana would it?
This your last warning - shut up! Weiss needs strong boss - that is how we survive. For now, Mother is strongest boss. Some day, Don't Know What will be strongest boss. Otherwise trolls die out.
This'll get that mangy fox!
This, [player name], is the Ardougne Resistance!
This, me hearty, is the entrance to the Brimhaven Agility Arena!
This, my friend, is where we train. Here we improve our agility. It's an essential skill.
This, of course, was before he was driven insane by his research and ran off into the desert, screaming.
This... This is VERY strange!
This... idea! The idea of something nice! Those nice little tokens!
This... this is fascinating! These cuneiforms seem to predate even the settlement we are excavating here... Yes, yes, this is most interesting indeed!
This... this is incredible.
This... this is incredible. Please, give me a few moments to quickly look over this, and then talk to me again.

This? It's a Hunter's Skillcape. It shows that I am a true master of the art of Hunting and provides five daily teleports to either the Feldip Hills or Wilderness Hunter areas. If you ever manage to train your
This? This fresh, but it no good to me raw! You go use range in kitchen!
This? This is a Skillcape of Crafting. It is a symbol of my ability as master of the Crafting Guild and it provides unlimited teleports here.
Thish areash resh... restricted! We don't like strangersh... 'specially ones who sway. Oooh!
Thish here'sh a shtore room right?
Thish ish a besht of three game. Nowsh, pick what you are going to shhhow.
Thisss and that. Whatever out massster desssiresss.
Thisss isss our temple, we don't usssually get many visssitorsss... We make sssacrifice, offeringsss to our massster.
Thisss isss where I belong... Beingsss sssuch as myssself cannot abide in the light... It is in the darknesss where we find our homesss...
Thorgel
Thorkel, can you tell me about this taxation?
Thorobshuun tribe colour is red! Way better than silly green of Garagorshuun tribe.
Thorodin
Thorodin and Donal were working on it earlier, but I hear Donal's run off to hide in the inn.
Thorodin, taskmaster for the Fremennik Achievement Diary.
Thorvald
Thorvald the Warrior
Those Etceterian soldiers?
Those Khazard troops continue to be a menace, but things are much better now. All thanks to you, of course.
Those Menaphites would never do that. They have no sense of honour.
Those accursed poison spiders that surround the entrance to Chronozon's lair... I must have taken a nip from one of them as I attempted to make my escape.
Those animals... how could they do that to poor Scruffy? What kind of lowlife would do that???
Those are all men with children to feed. Famished families. Worried wives. All of us rely on this shipyard.
Those are banknotes! I can't use those!
Those are highly technical tools. They're not like the tools you use on the surface.
Those are keys to the houses round 'ere.
Those are my people coming for us. My brothers and sisters.
Those are really fine pieces of fur. Tell you what, I'll give you 150 gold pieces each for them.
Those are really fine pieces of fur. Tell you what, I'll give you 20 gold pieces each for them.
Those are some deep cuts on your legs.
Those are some of the traps to keep people away from this temple.
Those are the items I am interested in Bwana. If you want to sell me those items, simply show them to me.
Those aren't private thoughts! They're nothing compared to the other things I can see...
Those bandits would never agree to that. They couldn't afford even the mangiest excuse for a camel, never mind the desert traversing, four legged beauty that we would demand.
Those being?
Those bickering goblins... How did I protect them again?

Those blessings remain to this day, ensuring no vampyre can cross the river. The temple here was built soon after. It guards the source of the River Salve, and acts as the only passage into Morytania.
Those bones! Those are exactly the sort of thing I need! Will you sell them?
Those boxes from your friend Aubury have a very odd locking mechanism.
Those cheerleaders down the Gnomeball pitch...
Those children are nothing but trouble - if I did not watch them all the time, Seren knows what trouble they would get in to!
Those curtains are not going to be in any way opulent, matey.
Those damn broavs! Now I'll need to start over again!
Those disgusting entities are the filth that have ruined my life. They're the restless spirits of the dead who jealously guard their burial treasure yet feed on the  life force of the living.
Those experiments went extraordinarily well.
Those fairies that side with the Godfather are all traitors! The Queen is the true ruler of Zanaris!
Those fellows over in Lovakengj are an efficient bunch... They often produce far more than the army actually needs.
Those fungus rings would be a good starting point. Maybe you could use one of them to find another way to Yu'biusk. In the meantime, I'll keep trying to get the machine working again.
Those gems on the demon's throne look valuable. I just wish I had some way to remove them.
Those hooligans! They slaughtered my precious Scruffy! I shall never recover! I am emotionally scarred for life!
Those knights should also be loyal children of Ralos, but I agree, they are far more likely candidates. Let us investigate them and see what we can find.
Those lizardmen gotta die! Ya hear me? I want them all dead! All of 'em!
Those look like my friend Tiffy's armour.
Those look like strong fangs. You could probably attach them to a bow to make it stronger.
Those lucky ones to the west of the Salve little realise their fate if the river should one day become tainted.
Those monsters! How has Safalaan taken this?
Those mourners came and whisked him away. He didn't even seem that ill, I thought it was a common cold... But the mourners said that he was infected and had to be taken away.
Those must be the parts for the machine they're going to use to flood my city!
Those nets are strange.
Those nice people might have given you anything you liked, if it would make you stop damaging their village.
Those orbs are volatile, they use some very old magic, no worshipper of Saradomin would dare touch one. You must return to this monk and find out more, but be wary.
Those other monsters were just hallucinations!
Those peasants...where did they come from?
Those people just don't want us to succeed. Don't listen to them!
Those pesky thingummywuts. They get everywhere. They leave a terrible mess too.
Those planks cost 100 coins. You don't have enough money for all of them.
Those planks cost [X] coins. You don't have enough money for all of them.
